detectors.detail: 1 in-flight requests never produced a row (1 after a 200 OK)

thoughts.text: An n8n worker pod was killed during the trace (K8S EVENTS: Killing n8n-worker-6cd6854ff5-8nqkn).
The deterministic detector reports '1 in-flight requests never produced a row (1 after a 200 OK)'.
The worker was terminated while processing a job, leading to a lost in-flight task because graceful shutdown or proper signal handling was not maintained.
The fates section indicates one 'lost_silently' execution resulting from the worker termination.
Failing to maintain proper graceful shutdown during worker lifecycle events causes in-flight jobs to be lost silently without writing to Postgres.

root_cause: Termination of the n8n worker pod without graceful shutdown handling causes in-flight execution jobs to be lost silently.
failure_chain: A worker pod is scheduled for termination by Kubernetes.
The container receives a stop signal without proper graceful shutdown configuration or completion handling.
The active in-flight job execution is abruptly cut off.
The job fails to complete its database write, resulting in lost work.

findings.title: Lost in-flight work during worker termination

fixes.why: Ensures active jobs finish processing or are safely returned to the queue before the worker container exits.
